subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for pending exec approvals be read-only list/JSON only, or should it also include approval resolve/respond and watch behavior?
rationale: The missing CLI surface is clear, but exposing pending command text and especially submitting decisions crosses the exec approval security boundary and needs maintainer intent for the authority model.

options.title: Ship List/JSON First
options.body: Expose read-only pending/list output through the existing list RPC and handle resolve/respond and watch in separate security-scoped follow-ups.

options.title: Adopt Broader CLI Control
options.body: Let the active related PR own both listing and resolving after it proves the authority path, live behavior, and docs contract.

options.title: Defer CLI Exposure
options.body: Keep inspection in current backend/UI paths until maintainers decide that a CLI operator recovery surface is worth the added security contract.

recommendation.title: Ship List/JSON First
recommendation.body: Expose read-only pending/list output through the existing list RPC and handle resolve/respond and watch in separate security-scoped follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest approvals CLI/docs history and already provided concrete scoping guidance on this issue.
